browser: Chrome 155 (Playwright, Apple silicon, 120 Hz display => 8.3 ms frame = vsync bound)
graph: 1000 nodes, 2500 edges, 20 clusters, precomputed positions (d3-force 300 ticks)
method: median of 5 page loads; mount = construct + 2 rAF; frames = 90 programmatic camera/viewport/pan steps awaiting rAF
caveats: xyflow nodes are real React DOM nodes with labels (functional UI); cytoscape/sigma/canvas draw no per-node labels in this test; panning only (no hover/selection); single machine.
